description: This script updates a README file with release information and manifest comparisons for a Raspberry Pi vendor project.

methods.name: fetch_manifest_xml
methods.description: Fetches manifest XML content from a URL based on manifest name and release tag.

methods.name: parse_manifest
methods.description: Parses the manifest XML to extract Yocto version and layer revisions.

methods.name: generate_table_single
methods.description: Generates a markdown table listing layers and their revisions.

methods.name: generate_table_compare
methods.description: Generates a markdown comparison table between two sets of layer revisions.
